summary: An angel investor announces on X their investment in trade(xyz), a trading platform building on Hyperliquid. The post highlights a partnership between trade(xyz) and ICE (Intercontinental Exchange) to bring 24/7 perpetual futures on Hyperliquid to the United States. This matters because it signals major TradFi-crypto convergence: one of the world's largest exchange operators is backing US-accessible perpetual futures via a Hyperliquid-based platform.
